description: NIST's CTC-05, its AP203-with-PMI edition's solid #249 (the committed excerpt real/nist-ctc-05-ap203-torus-elbow-s5): the convex edge between the rational B-spline face f109, degree (3, 2) over 2 × 1 spans, and the torus f111, filleted alone at the battery's radius. The edge's curve is a cubic B-spline that is no circle (off the best by 9.3e-3), the face's least principal radius on the ball's side over the stripe is 127 against r 0.889, and both ends lie on the face's domain boundary with a cylinder across (f10, f19), each a vertex of three edges, so the ball's reach past either end leaves the B-spline's domain by r (a tenth of its width there). Arris refuses it Unsupported(NURBS surface × torus surface); Open CASCADE builds a body BRepCheck_Analyzer finds invalid, whose measures are the oracle's (plans/nurbs-face-blend step 1). The desired result is a walked stripe matching them
